I am kinda of at a lost about what to post about lately :sweatsmile: I've been in such a healthy mental space, I'm like, "wow there is no turmoil i could post about." lol. Sorry I have been treating this blog like a vent. >____<;;; I've had a lot of feelings I needed to process over the last year. And hopefully I can I stay in this healthy space!

Honestly, it's weird because I feel like I could post a lot more helpful content now like tutorials (maybe lol). Would you like to see any?

Here's a coordinate from the other day when I had tea with a friend. We also went antiquing afterwards!

My antiquing haul! I was so happy about the teddy bear~ He looks soooo cute, I need to think of a name for him!

The rest of the finds were vintage materials I can use for making items for rabbit reverie, my brand!

I feel happy I can meet this friend so casually. She lives far, but she made the trek to see me ^_^

In other news, I started crafting flowers again! I plan on making these to sell for rabbit reverie.

Here's how it looks cutting out the petals.

I have to individually shape and iron each petal. I put them together in this box to keep organized ^_^

Here's how it looks after it's complete! Right is my flower and left is factory made (it's a little smashed). Which do you like more? It's ok if you don't like mine LOL.

It took me quite a few hours to make this batch.

I ended up making this hair bow with one of my completed flowers ^_^

Here are also some jabots I made! I only used premade flowers here.

I'll probably produce a mix of products with handmade or premade flowers. It's very labor intensive creating the flowers so I will refrain from using them exclusively as I'm afraid of burn out. I don't think most people will pay premium for them so I don't really wanna slave away for it if that makes sense ><

Here's also a batch of hair bows I made which I will be selling!
